post_install.name: ensure-default-choice-ollama-models
post_install.command: export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then _i=0; while [ "$_i" -lt 30 ]; do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; _i=$((_i + 1)); sleep 1; done; if ! command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then for _big in gemma2:27b gemma4:26b gemma4:latest gemma:latest; do ollama list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}' | grep -qx "$_big" && ollama rm "$_big" || true; done; fi; for _m in gemma:2b llama3.2:1b phi4-mini; do if ollama list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}' | grep -Eq "^${_m}(:latest)?$"; then printf '[REUSE] Model %s already present\n' "$_m"; else ollama pull "$_m" || true; fi; done; fi
post_install.cmd_windows: where ollama >nul 2>nul && (where nvidia-smi >nul 2>nul || (for %B in (gemma2:27b gemma4:26b gemma4:latest gemma:latest) do @(ollama list 2>nul | findstr /I /C:"%B" >nul && ollama rm %B))) && (for %M in (gemma:2b llama3.2:1b phi4-mini) do @(ollama list 2>nul | findstr /I /C:"%M" >nul && echo [REUSE] Model %M already present || ollama pull %M))
post_install.description: Ensure choice models (gemma:2b, llama3.2:1b, phi4-mini) are installed with Ollama after install and prune oversized/slow models on CPU-only nodes

' "$_src_hash" > dist/.libscript_src_hash && printf '%s
' "$_src_hash" > .libscript_build.sha256 && _cnt=$(find dist/pulse-query-ng-web/browser -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); _sz=$(du -sh dist/pulse-query-ng-web/browser 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); printf '[BUILD] [REUSE] Angular build (ng build) output verified at dist/pulse-query-ng-web/browser/index.html (%s files, %s, hash %s; pass --force-rebuild to re-run ng build).
' "${_cnt:-0}" "${_sz:-0B}" "$_src_hash"; else printf '[BUILD] [ng build] Building Angular frontend (pulse-query-ng-web, hash %s) -> dist/pulse-query-ng-web/browser/...
' "$_src_hash" && rm -rf dist .angular .libscript_build.sha256 && npm run build && _built_utc=$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC') && for _f in dist/pulse-query-ng-web/browser/*.js; do [ -f "$_f" ] && sed -i.bak -E "s/20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC/${_built_utc}/g" "$_f" && rm -f "${_f}.bak"; done && printf '%s

build.cmd_windows: if not "%FORCE_REBUILD%"=="1" if exist "dist\pulse-query-ng-web\browser\index.html" if exist ".libscript_build.sha256" if exist "dist\.libscript_src_hash" (echo [BUILD] [REUSE] Angular build ^(ng build^) output verified at dist\pulse-query-ng-web\browser\index.html ^(pass --force-rebuild to re-run ng build^).) else (echo [BUILD] [ng build] Building Angular frontend ^(pulse-query-ng-web^) -^> dist\pulse-query-ng-web\browser\... && npm run build && (set "_CFF_TMP=%TEMP%\libscript_fe_fp_%RANDOM%.txt" && (for %F in (package.json package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock angular.json vite.config.ts vite.config.js vite.config.mts tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.spec.json index.html) do @if exist "%F" for %Z in ("%F") do @echo %~nxZ:%~zZ:%~tZ>>"!_CFF_TMP!") && (if exist "src" for /r "src" %S in (*) do @echo %~nxS:%~zS:%~tS>>"!_CFF_TMP!") && (if exist "public" for /r "public" %P in (*) do @echo %~nxP:%~zP:%~tP>>"!_CFF_TMP!") && (for /f "skip=1 tokens=1" %H in ('certutil -hashfile "!_CFF_TMP!" db_migrate.name: ensure-postgres-role-and-db
db_migrate.command: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; elif [ -f ../.env ]; then set -a; . ../.env; set +a; fi; if [ -f .env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ./.env.secrets; set +a; elif [ -f ../.env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ../.env.secrets; set +a; fi; PG_ROLE="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}"; PG_PASS="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}"; PG_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}"; PG_HOST="${POSTGRES_SERVER:-127.0.0.1}"; PG_PORT="${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}"; if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then if PGPASSWORD="$PG_PASS" psql -h "$PG_HOST" -p "$PG_PORT" -U "$PG_ROLE" -d "$PG_DB" -c 'SELECT 1;' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '[REUSE] PostgreSQL role "%s" and database "%s" already exist.\n' "$PG_ROLE" "$PG_DB"; elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && id postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='${PG_ROLE}'" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE ROLE ${PG_ROLE} WITH SUPERUSER LOGIN PASSWORD '${PG_PASS}';" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${PG_DB}'" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE ${PG_DB} OWNER ${PG_ROLE};" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi
db_migrate.cmd_windows: where psql >nul 2>nul && (set "PGPASSWORD=%POSTGRES_PASSWORD%" && psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d pulse_query_db -c "SELECT 1;" >nul 2>nul && echo [REUSE] PostgreSQL role and database pulse_query_db already exist. || psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE pulse_query_db OWNER postgres;" >nul 2>nul) || rem PostgreSQL role and database check skipped when psql is not in PATH
db_migrate.description: Idempotently ensure PostgreSQL role and pulse_query_db database exist

db_migrate.name: alembic-upgrade-head
db_migrate.command:
if [ -f ../.env ]; then set -a; . ../.env; set +a; fi; if [ -f ../.env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ../.env.secrets; set +a; fi; export PATH="${SERVICE_EXTRA_PATH:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH" && _lock_hash=$(cksum uv.lock 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1"_"$2}' || printf 'none') && if [ "${FORCE_REINSTALL:-0}" != "1" ] && [ -x .venv/bin/alembic ] && [ -f .venv/.libscript_lock_hash ] && [ "$(cat .venv/.libscript_lock_hash 2>/dev/null)" = "$_lock_hash" ]; then printf '[REUSE] pulse-query-backend .venv lock hash unchanged (%s); skipping uv sync.
' "$_lock_hash"; else uv sync --python 3.12 && printf '%s
' "$_lock_hash" > .venv/.libscript_lock_hash; fi && printf '[UPSERT:POSTGRES] Running Alembic schema migrations on PostgreSQL "%s"...
' "${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}" && PYTHONPATH=src POSTGRES_SERVER="${POSTGRES_SERVER:-127.0.0.1}" POSTGRES_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}" POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}" uv run --no-sync alembic upgrade head && PYTHONPATH=src POSTGRES_SERVER="${POSTGRES_SERVER:-127.0.0.1}" POSTGRES_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}" POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}" uv run --no-sync alembic current
db_migrate.cmd_windows: echo [UPSERT:POSTGRES] Running Alembic schema migrations on PostgreSQL... && (if not exist ".venv\Scripts\alembic.exe" uv sync --python 3.12) && set PYTHONPATH=src&& uv run --no-sync alembic upgrade head && uv run --no-sync alembic current

db_migrate.name: ingest-clinical-datasets
db_migrate.command: if [ -f ../.env ]; then set -a; . ../.env; set +a; fi; if [ -f ../.env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ../.env.secrets; set +a; fi; if [ -f ../.env.libscript ]; then set -a; . ../.env.libscript; set +a; fi; export PATH="${SERVICE_EXTRA_PATH:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH"; if [ "${FORCE_REINSTALL:-0}" != "1" ] && [ "${LIBSCRIPT_FORCE_SEED:-0}" != "1" ]; then if [ "${LIBSCRIPT_DB_DUCKDB_POPULATED:-0}" = "1" ] || PYTHONPATH=src DUCKDB_PATH="${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}" uv run --no-sync python -c 'import os, sys, duckdb; p = os.environ.get("DUCKDB_PATH", "data/hospital_analytics.duckdb"); assert os.path.isfile(p); c = duckdb.connect(p, read_only=True); r1 = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hospital_data").fetchone()[0]; r2 = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Synthetic_hospital_data_transfers").fetchone()[0]; c.close(); sys.exit(0 if (r1 > 0 and r2 > 0) else 1)' 2>/dev/null; then printf '[REUSE] Clinical DuckDB datasets already populated at "%s"; skipping scripts/ingest.py.\n' "${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}"; exit 0; fi; fi; printf '[UPSERT:DUCKDB] Upserting clinical CSV datasets into DuckDB "%s"...\n' "${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}" && PYTHONPATH=src DUCKDB_PATH="${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}" uv run --no-sync python scripts/ingest.py
db_migrate.cmd_windows: if "%LIBSCRIPT_DB_DUCKDB_POPULATED%"=="1" if not "%FORCE_REINSTALL%"=="1" (echo [REUSE] Clinical DuckDB datasets already populated; skipping re-ingest.) else (set PYTHONPATH=src&& set DUCKDB_PATH=data\hospital_analytics.duckdb&& uv run --no-sync python -c "import os, sys, duckdb; p = os.environ.get('DUCKDB_PATH', 'data/hospital_analytics.duckdb'); assert os.path.isfile(p); c = duckdb.connect(p, read_only=True); r1 = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hospital_data').fetchone()[0]; r2 = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Synthetic_hospital_data_transfers').fetchone()[0]; c.close(); sys.exit(0 if (r1 > 0 and r2 > 0) else 1)" 2>nul && echo [REUSE] Clinical DuckDB datasets already populated; skipping re-ingest. || (echo [UPSERT:DUCKDB] Upserting clinical CSV datasets into DuckDB... && set PYTHONPATH=src&& set DUCKDB_PATH=data\hospital_analytics.duckdb&& uv run --no-sync python scripts/ingest.py))
db_migrate.description: Ingest synthetic clinical datasets into DuckDB

db_migrate.name: seed-dashboard-templates
db_migrate.cmd_windows: if "%LIBSCRIPT_DB_POSTGRES_POPULATED%"=="1" if not "%FORCE_REINSTALL%"=="1" (echo [REUSE] Query templates already seeded; skipping re-seed.) else (psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d pulse_query_db -tAc "SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM templates) >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END" 2>nul | findstr /C:"1" >nul && echo [REUSE] Query templates already seeded; skipping re-seed. || (echo [UPSERT:POSTGRES] Upserting dashboard templates from initial_templates.json into PostgreSQL... && set PYTHONPATH=src&& set DUCKDB_PATH=data\hospital_analytics.duckdb&& uv run --no-sync python scripts/seed_templates.py))
db_migrate.description: Seed initial clinical dashboard templates into PostgreSQL

before_start.command: export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then _i=0; while [ "$_i" -lt 30 ]; do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; _i=$((_i + 1)); sleep 1; done; if ! command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then for _big in gemma2:27b gemma4:26b gemma4:latest gemma:latest; do ollama list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}' | grep -qx "$_big" && ollama rm "$_big" || true; done; fi; for _m in gemma:2b llama3.2:1b phi4-mini; do if ollama list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}' | grep -Eq "^${_m}(:latest)?$"; then printf '[REUSE] Model %s already present\n' "$_m"; else ollama pull "$_m" || true; fi; done; fi

db_migrate.command: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; elif [ -f ../.env ]; then set -a; . ../.env; set +a; fi; if [ -f .env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ./.env.secrets; set +a; elif [ -f ../.env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ../.env.secrets; set +a; fi; PG_ROLE="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}"; PG_PASS="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}"; PG_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}"; PG_HOST="${POSTGRES_SERVER:-127.0.0.1}"; PG_PORT="${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}"; if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then if PGPASSWORD="$PG_PASS" psql -h "$PG_HOST" -p "$PG_PORT" -U "$PG_ROLE" -d "$PG_DB" -c 'SELECT 1;' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '[REUSE] PostgreSQL role "%s" and database "%s" already exist.\n' "$PG_ROLE" "$PG_DB"; elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && id postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='${PG_ROLE}'" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE ROLE ${PG_ROLE} WITH SUPERUSER LOGIN PASSWORD '${PG_PASS}';" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${PG_DB}'" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE ${PG_DB} OWNER ${PG_ROLE};" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi

db_migrate.description: Idempotently ensure PostgreSQL role and pulse_query_db database exist

' "$_lock_hash"; else uv sync --python 3.12 && printf '%s
' "$_lock_hash" > .venv/.libscript_lock_hash; fi && printf '[UPSERT:POSTGRES] Running Alembic schema migrations on PostgreSQL "%s"...
' "${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}" && PYTHONPATH=src POSTGRES_SERVER="${POSTGRES_SERVER:-127.0.0.1}" POSTGRES_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}" POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}" uv run --no-sync alembic upgrade head && PYTHONPATH=src POSTGRES_SERVER="${POSTGRES_SERVER:-127.0.0.1}" POSTGRES_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}" POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-pulse_query_db}" uv run --no-sync alembic current

db_migrate.name: ingest-clinical-datasets
db_migrate.command: if [ -f ../.env ]; then set -a; . ../.env; set +a; fi; if [ -f ../.env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ../.env.secrets; set +a; fi; if [ -f ../.env.libscript ]; then set -a; . ../.env.libscript; set +a; fi; export PATH="${SERVICE_EXTRA_PATH:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH"; if [ "${FORCE_REINSTALL:-0}" != "1" ] && [ "${LIBSCRIPT_FORCE_SEED:-0}" != "1" ]; then if [ "${LIBSCRIPT_DB_DUCKDB_POPULATED:-0}" = "1" ] || PYTHONPATH=src DUCKDB_PATH="${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}" uv run --no-sync python -c 'import os, sys, duckdb; p = os.environ.get("DUCKDB_PATH", "data/hospital_analytics.duckdb"); assert os.path.isfile(p); c = duckdb.connect(p, read_only=True); r1 = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hospital_data").fetchone()[0]; r2 = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Synthetic_hospital_data_transfers").fetchone()[0]; c.close(); sys.exit(0 if (r1 > 0 and r2 > 0) else 1)' 2>/dev/null; then printf '[REUSE] Clinical DuckDB datasets already populated at "%s"; skipping scripts/ingest.py.\n' "${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}"; exit 0; fi; fi; printf '[UPSERT:DUCKDB] Upserting clinical CSV datasets into DuckDB "%s"...\n' "${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}" && PYTHONPATH=src DUCKDB_PATH="${DUCKDB_PATH:-data/hospital_analytics.duckdb}" uv run --no-sync python scripts/ingest.py

pre_start.description: Ensure persistent data directory exists before starting services

pre_start.name: ensure-service-user-data-ownership
pre_start.command: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; if [ -f .env.secrets ]; then set -a; . ./.env.secrets; set +a; fi; DATA_DIR="${DATA_MOUNT_DIR:-./data}"; TARGET_USER="${SERVICE_USER:-$(whoami)}"; TARGET_GROUP="${SERVICE_GROUP:-$TARGET_USER}"; if [ -d "$DATA_DIR" ] && id "$TARGET_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo chown -R "${TARGET_USER}:${TARGET_GROUP}" "$DATA_DIR" && sudo chmod -R u+rwX,go+rX "$DATA_DIR"; fi
pre_start.cmd_windows: rem Data directory permissions managed by Windows ACLs
pre_start.description: Ensure configured service user owns data directory before starting backend service

pre_start.name: ensure-default-choice-ollama-models
pre_start.command: export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then _i=0; while [ "$_i" -lt 30 ]; do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; _i=$((_i + 1)); sleep 1; done; if ! command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then for _big in gemma2:27b gemma4:26b gemma4:latest gemma:latest; do ollama list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}' | grep -qx "$_big" && ollama rm "$_big" || true; done; fi; for _m in gemma:2b llama3.2:1b phi4-mini; do if ollama list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $1}' | grep -Eq "^${_m}(:latest)?$"; then printf '[REUSE] Model %s already present\n' "$_m"; else ollama pull "$_m" || true; fi; done; fi
pre_start.cmd_windows: where ollama >nul 2>nul && (where nvidia-smi >nul 2>nul || (for %B in (gemma2:27b gemma4:26b gemma4:latest gemma:latest) do @(ollama list 2>nul | findstr /I /C:"%B" >nul && ollama rm %B))) && (for %M in (gemma:2b llama3.2:1b phi4-mini) do @(ollama list 2>nul | findstr /I /C:"%M" >nul && echo [REUSE] Model %M already present || ollama pull %M))
pre_start.description: Ensure choice models (gemma:2b, llama3.2:1b, phi4-mini) are installed with Ollama before start and prune oversized/slow models on CPU-only nodes

health.name: verify-system-health-payload
health.command: curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/system/health | jq -e '.status == "healthy" and .datasets.status == "ready" and .datasets.table_count >= 2 and (.datasets.row_counts.hospital_data // 0) > 0 and .templates.status == "ready" and .templates.template_count >= 10'

health.name: verify-ai-models-connected
health.command: curl -sf 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/ai/models?discover_ollama=true' | jq -e 'any(.[]; (.id == "ollama:gemma:2b" or .id == "gemma:2b") and .status == "connected") and all(.[]; .status == "connected")'
